questions.question: / decision contexts. Explain why selecting an appropriate visual display is important in data
questions.solution_html:
• contexts.
  • Visual representation is more effective than textual reports in decision contexts because it
  • leverages the human brain's natural ability to process visual information rapidly, often
  • identifying patterns, trends, and anomalies at a glance that would take hours to uncover in
  • raw data. Visual stories make information easier to understand and analyse and communicate.
  • visuals reduce cognitive load. Instead of reading through dense paragraphs or tables, a chart
  • or graph summarizes large amounts of data at a glance. This allows decision-makers to grasp
  • key insights quickly without mentally stitchingtogether scattered details.
  • Discrete data – This is a type of data in statistics that only uses discrete values or
  • single values .eg: Number ofstudents inaclass, Numberoffamily members etc
questions.final_answer: single values .eg: Number ofstudents inaclass, Numberoffamily members etc
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: / storytelling.
questions.solution_html:
• Selecting an appropriate visual display is important in data storytelling because it transforms
  • complex, raw data into a clear, engaging, and accurate narrative that drives action. The right
  • visual reduces cognitive load, allowing the audience to grasp insights in seconds rather than
  • wasting timeinterpreting confusing ormisleading graphs
  • Continuous data – it is a type data that represent the data in continuous range eg
  • weight ofeachstudent in a class, salary of workers in factory etc
questions.final_answer: weight ofeachstudent in a class, salary of workers in factory etc

questions.question: State any three uses of the data visualization tool.
questions.solution_html:
• Data visualization toolsare used toturn raw data intoclear, actionableinsights across many
  • fields.
  •  Used in business intelligence and decision-making- Tools like Tableau and
  • Microsoft Power BI help organizations track performance through dashboards
  • revealing trends in sales, customer behaviour, and operations
  •  Used for data exploration and analysis - Instead of scanning spread sheets, analysts
  • usevisuals to uncover hiddenpatterns, correlations, andanomalies
  •  In communication and reporting, visualizations make findings easier to present to
  • stakeholders
  •  Real-time monitoring. - Many industries rely on live dashboards to track systems
  • such as website traffic, financial markets, or supply chains. Visual alerts and trend
  • lines allowquickresponses to changes orissues.
  •  Public policy and governance- visualizations help communicate data like population
  • trends, economic indicators, orhealth statisticsto thepublic.
  •  Used inmarketing and customer analytics
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss three examples of geographical data used in real life. / State any two importance of Data Visualization in Agricultural Research
questions.solution_html:
• Geographical data refers to data that represents the location shape and characteristics of
  • features onearth’ssurface
  •  Navigationand routeplanning
  • Apps like Google Maps use geographical data such as road networks, traffic
  • conditions,and userlocation to suggest thefastest routes and estimate travel time.
  •  Weatherforecasting
  • Meteorological departments use geographic data like latitude, altitude, and satellite
  • imagery to predict weather patterns
  •  Urbanplanning andsmartcities
  • City planners use geographical data to design roads, public transport, drainage
  • systems, and zoning areas. Population density maps and land-use maps help decide
  • where tobuild schools, hospitals, orparks.
  •  Disastermanagement
  • During floods, earthquakes, or landslides, geographic data helps identify high-risk
  • zonesand plan evacuation routes.
  •  Agriculture
  • Farmers and agricultural agencies use data on soil type, rainfall, and land elevation to
  • decide which crops togrow andwhen toplant or harvest
  •  Transportation andlogistics
  • Delivery services use geographic data for route optimization, tracking shipments, and
  • reducing fuel costs. GPSsystems help companies manage fleets efficiently.
questions.final_answer: reducing fuel costs. GPSsystems help companies manage fleets efficiently
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: / Application
questions.solution_html:
• Data visualization plays a central role in agricultural research because it turns complex
  • multi-layered farm data intoinsights that researchers and farmers can actually use.
  •  Understanding patterns incrops and environment
  •  Visualizationdashboards allowresearchers and policymakers tocompare crop
  • performance across regions, seasons, orfarming techniques.
  •  Efficient useofgeographicdata
  •  Visual analytics can reveal anomalies suchas sudden drops in crop health, pest
  • infestations, ordisease spread.
  •  Enhancing communication and collaboration
  •  Supportingsustainable farming practices

questions.question: Identify scenarios where Python is preferred over BI tools.
questions.solution_html:
• Python is preferred over BI toolsbecause itoffers flexibilityand depth that many BI
  • platforms can’t match. Someofthereasons are
  •  Unlimitedcustomization and flexibility
  •  Advanced data processing
  •  Integrationwith machine learning
  •  Large data sets
  •  Reproducibilityand version control
  •  Costand open source
  •  Automationand scalability
